Catches compass-agent's OWN meta-errors. v1.0 (2026-05-11) seeded with 18+22 from L2-not-live + close-loop-verification + dual-flywheel cases. v1.1 (2026-05-12) refit with 4 caught-by-self fake-closures from MCP wire saga: (a) service restart treated as root-cause fix (only cleared queue), (b) smoke used convenient 10s idle gap not production 10-15min P95, (c) stacked retry+keepalive as 'double insurance' without verifying each link independent, (d) used agent_tool_calls success-row count as 'recall flowing' signal but soft-fails don't write DB so failures invisible. v1.2 (2026-05-13) adds cross-dialog handoff close-loop pair: outbound session_*.md mandatory after inbound consumed (Telegram fires within 5min instead of upstream ssh-grep) + intermediate partial-status outbound when stuck mid-ship (terminal-only signaling is incomplete). Purpose: prevent compass agent itself from shipping fake closures of its own meta work · use as second-pass drift_check on session_*.md before ingest_obs with proof_of_recall=pass.
